posts.text: A mere five years before breaking the record for the biggest public stock offering ever, Anthropic began as a Silicon Valley startup when its founders broke away from OpenAI with their own ideas about how to develop artificial intelligence.

posts.text: Column: About 8 in 10 Republican registered voters approve of President Trump, but 40 percent “strongly approve,” down from 48 percent who said this one week before the election, according to a new poll.
